entities.name: Sylvene
entities.description: A powerful wizard from Ravnica who explored the Sword Coast decades ago, made allies there, and left with her young son.

entities.name: Tyreus
entities.description: Sylvene's grandson, whose greed for power knows no bounds and who is drawn to her hidden treasures.

entities.name: Sword Coast
entities.description: The region of Faerun where Sylvene adventured.

entities.name: Sylvene's crypt
entities.description: A grand crypt built in a verdant land to commemorate her allies, where she hid valuable treasures.

events.summary: Sylvene adventures on the Sword Coast and eventually returns with her young son to Ravnica.
events.quote: eventually departed with her young son, back to their home plane of Ravnica

events.summary: A grand crypt is built in a verdant land to commemorate her allies, and Sylvene hides valuable treasures in it.
events.quote: Many of those memories were celebrated and commemorated with the construction of a grand crypt in a verdant land

events.summary: The crypt's treasures attract adventurers and Sylvene's greedy grandson Tyreus.
events.quote: the attention of her grandson, Tyreus, whose greed for power knows no bounds

relations.quote: the attention of her grandson, Tyreus, whose greed for power knows no bounds

relations.note: The crypt commemorates her allies on the Sword Coast.
